description.narrative: Corruption Hunters network is a network against corruption with participants from between 15-20 countries mostly prosecutors and head of anti-corruption agencies, and special invited persons. from academia, media and civil society. The network has met regularly since 2004 with a handful of the original members still participating, By late 2023 the participants/guests come from: Zambia, Namibia, South Africa, Nigeria, Malawi, Argentina, Costa Rica, Sao Tome e Pricipe, Brazil, Ukraine, Italy, Switzerland, France, Norway, Sweden, Germany, USA, Lebanon and the Mena region.
